lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，肚子不离土。
lines.en: I travel pressed to the ground, belly on the soil.

lines.zh: 一根枯枝被我绕过，没碰响。
lines.en: I slip around a dry twig without a sound.
I coil once, then push forward.

lines.zh: 落叶底下更凉，我钻进去。
lines.en: It's cooler under the leaves, so I slide in.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩缝走，缝正合身。
lines.en: I follow the rock seam; it fits me perfectly.
The grass parts for me and closes behind.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土烫，我走快些。
lines.en: The red dirt of the badlands burns, so I hurry.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，那里有阳光。
lines.en: I avoid the stones; the sun lies on them.

lines.zh: 尾巴最后才过去，慢一点。
lines.en: My tail passes last, a little behind the rest.

lines.zh: 往上爬树，鳞片抓得住皮。
lines.en: I climb the trunk; my scales grip the bark.

lines.zh: 有一道浅浅的痕，是我留下的。
lines.en: There's a faint line behind me, and it's mine.

lines.zh: 我盘成一团，歇一歇再走。
lines.en: I coil into a knot and rest before moving on.
I hold perfectly still, like a branch.
My tongue slips out and back in.

lines.zh: 我听见叶子下面有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something stirring beneath the leaves.
The sun polishes my scales.

lines.zh: 身体里的温度在慢慢升。
lines.en: The warmth is creeping through my body.

lines.zh: 这个位置有点凉了，我再挪挪。
lines.en: This spot has cooled; I'll shift a little.

lines.zh: 眼皮很重，但我不全闭上。
lines.en: My lids are heavy, but I never close them fully.

lines.zh: 那只兔子刚才还在这儿。
lines.en: That rabbit was right here a moment ago.
I rub my jaw against the bark.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我像个绳结。
lines.en: In the quiet I look like a knot of rope.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的气味吹走了。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent away.

lines.zh: 有人吹笛子？我抬起了头。
lines.en: Is someone playing a flute? My head lifts.
Coiled up is the cheapest way to wait.
My shadow is thinner than I am.

lines.zh: 又一次蜕皮的日子快到了。
lines.en: The day for shedding is coming again.

lines.zh: 我试了试牙，还没到时候。
lines.en: I test my fangs; not yet.
A small insect crawls out of the crack.
I watch it until it stops moving.
Don't move; I'm deciding about you.
You're much taller than you look from here.
Your foot is very close to me.
I lift only the front of my body.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味是新洗过的。
lines.en: You smell freshly washed.
My fangs aren't venomous, but they still bite.
Play that tune and I'll come to you.
Is that raw rabbit in your hand?

lines.zh: 我们之间只有一层落叶。
lines.en: Only a layer of leaves lies between us.
I tilt my head at your shadow.
You stepped back, so I rose a little higher.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear every breath you take.

lines.zh: 我不是在威胁，只是好奇。
lines.en: I'm not threatening you, only curious.

lines.zh: 你的手腕冷吗？我很暖和。
lines.en: Is your wrist cold? I'm quite warm.
Wait a moment longer and I'll leave.
Don't grab me; it frightens me.
I snap into a tight coil.
It hurts; I lower my head.
Who stepped on me? My tail lashes.
A few scales have been torn up.
I hiss and retreat into the grass.
The wound is shallow but burning.
My whole length goes rigid.

lines.zh: 鳞片翻起，我记住了这味道。
lines.en: A scale lifts; I remember this scent.
I'll hide first and think later.
I'm slithering a little crooked.
Raw rabbit — I know that smell.
I slide toward your hand.

lines.zh: 那支曲子还在响，我越来越近。
lines.en: The tune keeps playing, and I come closer.
That piece isn't big for me.
I'll sniff first, then decide.

lines.zh: 舌头尝到了空气里的肉味。
lines.en: My tongue tastes meat in the air.
Hold still; I'm afraid you'll drop it.
I've wound around your wrist now.

lines.zh: 可以被喂了，我是这么想的。
lines.en: I do believe I can be fed now.
One more piece, and I'll follow you.
What's soft under your foot is me.

lines.zh: 我立刻盘成防御的一团。
lines.en: I coil into a defensive knot at once.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我的盘，我得重新绕。
lines.en: You broke my coil, so I must wind it again.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片有点硬，会磨人。
lines.en: My scales are hard enough to chafe.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的腿往上爬了一截。
lines.en: I climbed a short way up your leg.
That wasn't an attack; I was finding a way.
We both froze.
When your breath caught, I sprang away.

lines.zh: 地面太滑，我滑到了你鞋边。
lines.en: The ground is slick; I slid to your boot.
Don't push me; I will bite.
Another snake slides out of the crack.
We touch foreheads, very lightly.
Our bodies twine into a knot.
I rub my chin along her back.
This season, the soil holds warmth.
We coil together on the flat stone.

lines.zh: 我们的尾尖在草里碰了碰。
lines.en: Our tail tips touch in the grass.

lines.zh: 之后各走各的，蛇都这样。
lines.en: Afterward we part; that's how snakes are.

lines.zh: 别过来，我们现在很警觉。
lines.en: Stay back; we're watchful right now.

lines.zh: 这堆落叶刚好够藏两个。
lines.en: This heap of leaves hides two of us nicely.
I open wide and swallow the meat whole.
No chewing; straight down.
Now I'll be digesting for a while.
My mouth is full and I refuse to move.

lines.zh: 吞下比自己头还大的东西，正常。
lines.en: Swallowing something wider than my head is normal.

lines.zh: 我得找个暖和的地方躺着。
lines.en: I need a warm place to lie down.

lines.zh: 牙没派上用场，只是含住。
lines.en: The fangs weren't needed; I only held it.

lines.zh: 这条腿骨吞不下去，我吐出来。
lines.en: This leg bone won't go down, so I spit it out.
My throat bulges as it goes down.
My belly is heavy, so I move slowly.
That rabbit has stopped.

lines.zh: 我把头抬到能扑的高度。
lines.en: I raise my head to striking height.
It's less than an arm's length away.
Target fixed; my body draws tight.

lines.zh: 羽毛的声音，我听出来了。
lines.en: I can tell that sound; those are feathers.
Its feet rustle the leaves.
I'll stay still and let it come closer.
My tongue retracts; I'm ready.
This strike has to be precise.

lines.zh: 兔子一抬头，我就弹出去。
lines.en: The rabbit lifts its head; I strike.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体绕成弹簧。
lines.en: I slowly wind my body into a spring.

lines.zh: 它往哪边，我的头就跟哪边。
lines.en: Wherever it goes, my head follows.
I slide low across the ground, silent.
Half a block closer and it's in reach.
Its heartbeat has gone irregular.

lines.zh: 我的颈弯成 S 形。
lines.en: My neck curls into an S.
The grass hides it, not from me.
It wants to leap, so I coil tighter.
I hold only one target at a time.
My mouth is starting to water.
I spring forward and clamp down.
My fangs sink into its hide.
I wrap around it and squeeze by degrees.
I shake my head and flip it over.
I hold on until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 毒牙只擦过，你还站得住。
lines.en: My fangs only graze; you can still stand.
It struggled twice and went limp.
I coil up neatly before swallowing.
My mouth is full of the taste of blood.
I misjudged and only got a tuft of fur.
I poke my head out from under the leaves.
There's a new scent in the woods.

lines.zh: 我展开身体，比看上去长。
lines.en: I uncoil, longer than I looked.
The stone is just right for basking.
I come out of a seam in the badlands.
First a circuit, to learn the edges.
I hear a flute far away.
The grass is tall enough to hide me.
My tongue tastes this new ground.
There are plenty of rabbits here.
I pick the flattest path.

lines.zh: 我从草里立起来，比草高一头。
lines.en: I rise from the grass, a head taller than it.

lines.zh: 火苗燎过脊背，鳞片卷起来了。
lines.en: Flame passed over my back and my scales curled.

lines.zh: 从树上掉下来，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I fell from the tree and my head is spinning.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我缠不住任何东西。
lines.en: Water pours in and I can't grip anything.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀到半空又落下。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and drops me again.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在地上，我扭不开。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the ground and I can't twist free.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的身体不再听使唤。
lines.en: That light makes my body stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 肚子空得发瘪，我滑不动了。
lines.en: My belly is so flat I can barely slide.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边的树上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning struck the tree beside me and my whole body jolted.

lines.zh: 身下没有地面，我一直在落。
lines.en: There's no ground beneath me and I keep falling.
